tools.name: netdrive_status
tools.title: Network drives
tools.description: The user's network drives (rclone mounts as folders in home, e.g. a Storage Box at ~/Storage/Files): each one's name, source (ssh HOST or an rclone remote), path, read_only, enabled (mounts at login), state (mounted; connecting: waiting for its host, e.g. offline; failed; off; stale: a leftover mount), detail (the service's own line), uploads (files saved but not uploaded yet) and failed_uploads. line says it in a sentence. Use it before reading or writing files under a drive's path: a drive that isn't mounted is an empty read-only folder, and without a network a file not opened before fails to open after up to ~40 s.
